bibliography.title: Online Learning and Equilibrium Computation with Ranking Feedback

sections.title: 5 Online Learning with InstUtil Rank Feedback
6 Online Learning with AvgUtil Rank Feedback

abstract_sentences.text: Online learning in arbitrary, and possibly adversarial, environments has been extensively studied in sequential decision-making, and it is closely connected to equilibrium computation in game theory.

Most existing online learning algorithms rely on numeric utility feedback from the environment, which may be unavailable in human-in-the-loop applications and/or may be restricted by privacy concerns.

evidence.anchor: numeric utility feedback may be unavailable

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we study an online learning model in which the learner only observes a ranking over a set of proposed actions at each timestep.

evidence.anchor: only observes a ranking over proposed actions

abstract_sentences.text: We consider two ranking mechanisms: rankings induced by the instantaneous utility at the current timestep, and rankings induced by the time-average utility up to the current timestep, under both full-information and bandit feedback settings.
Using the standard external-regret metric, we show that sublinear regret is impossible with instantaneous-utility ranking feedback in general.

evidence.anchor: sublinear regret is impossible with instantaneous-utility ranking feedback

abstract_sentences.text: Moreover, when the ranking model is relatively deterministic, i.e., under the Plackett-Luce model with a temperature that is sufficiently small, sublinear regret is also impossible with time-average utility ranking feedback.
We then develop new algorithms that achieve sublinear regret under the additional assumption that the utility sequence has sublinear total variation.
Notably, for full-information time-average utility ranking feedback, this additional assumption can be removed.

evidence.anchor: full-information time-average ... assumption can be removed

abstract_sentences.text: As a consequence, when all players in a normal-form game follow our algorithms, repeated play yields an approximate coarse correlated equilibrium.

evidence.anchor: repeated play yields an approximate coarse correlated equilibrium

abstract_sentences.text: We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithms in an online large-language-model routing task.

evidence.anchor: numeric utility feedback may not always be available
fundamental limits and algorithmic solutions ... remain elusive
external regret we focus on here

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把 ranking-only feedback 视为 cardinal utility 被压缩后的在线学习问题：PL pairwise marginal 让 utility 可估计，时间平均让反馈更稳定；在 small-τ 处先证明不可辨识，再用 utility/strategy variation 与 stable numeric oracle 构造 sublinear regret，最后转成 repeated-game 的 approximate CCE。[p.4–10 §3–§8]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 主文保留四格 feedback model、Table 1 的 lower/upper-bound 矩阵、Theorems 4.1/4.3/4.4/5.1/5.2/6.2/6.3/7.2/7.3 的条件与量级、Algorithm 1–3 的概念链、CCE 结论及 LLM Figure 2。[p.3–10]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A–B 后置相关工作与 NFG formalism；C 后置多数实验、grid、seeds、noise；D–E 后置 hardness/estimator proofs；F 后置 pseudocode/diagrams；G–L 后置 formal regret proofs、game transfer 与 FTRL lemma；M 后置结论/限制。[p.15–46]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 让四种反馈/信息格的 hardness 与 assumptions 可横向核对；Algorithm 1 的 pairwise reduction、Theorem 5.1 的误差分解、Theorem 5.2/6.2/6.3 的 oracle-transfer 结构把机制、保证和边界连起来。[p.3,p.6–9,p.24]
final_judgment.largest_gap: AvgUtil bandit 在 constant τ 且无 Assumption 4.2 时仍未闭合；实验缺少 numeric-feedback/其他 ranking baseline 与真实 human ranking，且 hyperparameters 在固定 horizon 选择最佳配置；Figure 3 caption 与坐标存在可见不一致。[p.9–10,p.17–20,p.46]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先用一个 setting matrix 明确反馈生成、信息可见性、τ 与 variation 的适用边界，再让每个 positive theorem 对应一个 estimator mechanism、一个可证伪曲线和一个 failure regime。[p.3,p.5–10]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于 finite-action、PL ranking、i.i.d. with-replacement proposal 与 external-regret/CCE 链；不能据此推出真实用户偏好、稳定匹配、公平部署或非-PL ranking 的效果。[p.4,p.10–11,p.15–17]

formal_objects.label: Assumption 6.1
formal_objects.content: oracle output is Lipschitz in the cumulative utility sequence with L=Θ(T^(−c)), c∈(0,1).

formal_objects.label: Assumption 7.1
formal_objects.content: one-step strategy change is bounded by η=Θ(T^(−w)), w∈(0,1).

formal_objects.label: Definition B.1

statistical_audit.aggregation: Appendix C says every hyperparameter configuration is evaluated over 10 seeds; CCE Figures 7–9 report 95% confidence intervals. Main Figure 2 and other curves do not specify the shaded-band aggregation in their local caption.
statistical_audit.decision_quantities: external regret R(T), bandit regret R(T), average regret curves, CCE exploitability ε, best fixed action/model in hindsight, and lower-bound expected regret.
statistical_audit.uncertainty: Theoretical bounds are high-probability in δ; synthetic/game curves use 10 random seeds; no hypothesis tests, multiple-comparison correction, bootstrap, Bayesian analysis, regression, or effect-size analysis is reported.
statistical_audit.mechanism_evidence: Mechanism evidence is analytic: pairwise PL identity, estimator error decomposition, oracle stability, exploration lower bound, and strategy-variation transfer; empirical curves are validation rather than identification of a causal effect.
statistical_audit.adverse_reading: Best-config selection at horizon T is explicitly outcome-based; no separate holdout or preregistered hyperparameter policy is described.

lexical_audit.basis: 全文正文与附录（排除 references，去除 PDF 换行断词）英文 token 的近似计数；公式碎片仍可能进入计数。
